t_signal_start.description: Start of the signal window that the decoder used, seconds. TIM-1, TIM-4.

t_signal_end.description: End of that window, seconds. TIM-4.

t_decoded.description: When the decoder finished, seconds. TIM-4.

t_emitted.description: When the producer sent the event, seconds. TIM-4.

lsl.description: LSL record of a header or a decision (8.2.7). Never a host name (LSL-C3).

ws.description: WebSocket record: header (WS-S2) or decision (WS-K4). The server removes the header record before the header reaches the trust layer.

ws_seq.description: WebSocket sequence number of an input event (WS-Q1) or of a decision on the decisions channel (WS-D1): an integer >= 1. The binding, not this schema, says when the key is required.

ws_t_sent.description: Transport stamp of the sender, seconds (WS-K3, TIM-5).

ws_t_recv.description: Transport stamp of the receiver, seconds (WS-K3, TIM-5).

lsl_clamped.description: Number of frame timestamps moved forward before this frame (LSL-C4).

lsl_dropped_before.description: Number of frames dropped before this frame (LSL-C4).

SignalQuality.known.description: VER-7: the enumeration values of SignalQuality are known values (data of a version that this schema implements).

Span.description: One span of an n-best item (4.7). The SDK validators do not check spans.

char_start.description: First code point of the span in text.

char_end.description: End of the span (exclusive), in code points.

TrustDecision.description: Trust layer output (section 6). JSON type "trust_decision". One message for all three profiles; profile selects the rules. Not expressed in the schema (SDK checks): the order rules TD-4 ... TD-7, TD-11, INT-T4, CTL-T5 (need other lines); the trust rules TD-9, TD-12, INT-S1 ... INT-S10, CTL-S1 ... CTL-S8 (semantic rules of a trust layer); raw has one value per axis of velocity (two arrays). Fields of one profile (option json_profile) have their type only on decisions of that profile; on other decisions they are custom keys (PRF-5). Enumeration values: any string in the base schema; the known values are required unless spec_version is a newer minor version (VER-7, VER-8: TrustDecision.known). The action and state rules below name the known values that a profile does not allow, so a newer minor version may add values. INT-T7: an arm only on an OFFER. CTL-T8: level with radius.

spec_version.description: The version of the rules of this decision: "0.1" or "1.<minor>"; absent = "0.1". Required for 1.0 producers (VER-1, not a schema rule: a 0.1 producer omits it). TD-F3, VER-2, VER-3, VER-5.

is_final.description: false: a provisional preview. TD-F1, TD-1.

shown.description: Text profile: texts shown to the user; for COMMIT, shown[0] is the committed text. TD-F2, TD-8, TD-9, TD-10, TD-12, SEC-7.

p_top1.description: Confidence of the top candidate: a number in [0, 1] or null. TD-F1.

seq.description: Integer >= 0; increases strictly within a session. TD-F2, TD-5.

utterance.description: Integer >= 0; does not decrease. TD-F2, TD-5, TD-6.

config_id.description: Content id of the trust configuration; string or null. TD-F2.

input.description: Reference to the input. A JSON object (TD-F2); recommended keys: table 6.1.1 (informative). INT-S10, CTL-S8.

latency_s.description: Computation time of the decision, seconds; >= 0. TD-F2.

declaration.description: Result of the declaration check (DCL-5, DCL-6). A JSON object (TD-F2); recommended keys and types: table 6.1.2 (informative; consumers MUST NOT rely on them for safety).

reason.description: Short reason code or text, no personal content. SEC-5.

lsl.description: LSL record of a header or a decision (8.2.7). Never a host name (LSL-C3).

ws.description: WebSocket record: header (WS-S2) or decision (WS-K4). The server removes the header record before the header reaches the trust layer.

ws_seq.description: WebSocket sequence number of an input event (WS-Q1) or of a decision on the decisions channel (WS-D1): an integer >= 1. The binding, not this schema, says when the key is required.

ws_t_sent.description: Transport stamp of the sender, seconds (WS-K3, TIM-5).

ws_t_recv.description: Transport stamp of the receiver, seconds (WS-K3, TIM-5).

lsl_t.description: LSL timestamp of a marker event after the clock correction (LSL-C5).

t_source.description: The producer's own t of a JSON frame on the LSL events stream (LSL-C2).

lsl_clamped.description: Number of frame timestamps moved forward before this frame (LSL-C4).

lsl_dropped_before.description: Number of frames dropped before this frame (LSL-C4).

allOf.$comment: TD-8: a COMMIT with shown has at least one text
INT-T1, INT-T2, INT-T3: intent decisions
INT-T3: an intent COMMIT has intent and risk_class
INT-T3: an intent OFFER has a non-empty offered list
INT-T7: confirm_required (an arm) only on an intent OFFER
CTL-T1, CTL-T2, CTL-T4: control decisions
CTL-T3: act and attenuate go with COMMIT
CTL-T3: hold and stop go with ABSTAIN
CTL-T8: a control decision with radius has level
PRF-5: the control-profile fields have these types only on decisions with profile control

t.description: Time of a control decision, seconds (7.4.5). On other profiles a custom key (PRF-5; NTS 1.0 RC4).

tick.description: The input tick; integer >= 0. CTL-T1, CTL-T5.

velocity.description: Commanded velocity, 1-3 finite numbers. CTL-T4, CTL-T6, CTL-S1, CTL-S3.

raw.description: Decoder output before the gate, one value per axis. CTL-S6, CTL-S8.

ttl_s.description: Time to live of the command, seconds; > 0. CTL-T4, CTL-T6, CTL-S4.

engagement.description: Engagement counter; integer >= 0. CTL-T4, CTL-S5, CTL-S7.

authority.description: Decoder share of the commanded velocity; in [0, 1]. CTL-S5.

reasons.description: Reason codes: an open list (registry 12.3). Any string is valid; an unknown code is never read as "ok" (CTL-T9). CTL-S2, CTL-S8.

allOf.$comment: PRF-5: the intent-profile fields have these types only on decisions with profile intent

risk_class.description: Risk class of a COMMIT; null on other actions. INT-T3, INT-S3.

threshold.description: Commit threshold of the class; number in [0, 1] or null. INT-S3.

role.description: Role of the intent; JSON null if none. INT-S1.

confirm_required.description: true: an arm of an irreversible intent (7.3.1). INT-S4.

confirmation_of.description: The unit of the armed OFFER that this COMMIT executes. INT-S4.

undo_of.description: The unit of the COMMIT that this undo reverses. INT-S5.

pending_cleared.description: Why an armed intent was dropped.

allOf.$comment: VER-7, VER-8: without a newer minor spec_version (absent = 0.1), the enumeration values are known values; a newer minor version may use other strings

TrustDecision.known.description: VER-7: the enumeration values of TrustDecision are known values (data of a version that this schema implements).

allOf.$comment: PRF-5: the control-profile fields have known values only on decisions with profile control
PRF-5: the intent-profile fields have known values only on decisions with profile intent

Action.description: Decision action (6.1, registry 12.3). TD-F1. The intent profile uses COMMIT, OFFER, ABSTAIN (INT-T3); the control profile COMMIT, ABSTAIN.

ClockDomain.description: The clock of all times in a stream (5.3, registry 12.3). Rule: HDR-11.

ConfirmedVia.description: How an irreversible intent COMMIT was confirmed (7.3.5). INT-S4.

ControlState.description: State of a control decision (7.4.5, registry 12.3). CTL-T3.

ControlUnits.description: Control units (7.4.2, registry 12.3). CTL-D1: the units fit the quantity.

EnableSource.description: Channel of a control_enable event (7.4.4, registry 12.3).

IntentRole.description: Role of an intent (7.3.2, registry 12.3). INT-D1, INT-D3.

Profile.description: Output profile of a decision (7.1, registry 12.2). PRF-1, PRF-4.

RiskClass.description: Producer's risk class of an intent (7.3.2, registry 12.3). INT-D2, INT-S9.

ScoreSemantics.description: What a score means (section 4.6, registry 12.3). Rules: DEC-1 ... DEC-5.

Uncertainty.description: Uncertainty kind of control events (7.4.2). CTL-3.

VocabType.description: The kind of token in vocab (table 3.2, registry 12.3). Rules: HDR-5, HDR-14.
